The '''assault on the New Jedi Temple''' was a military operation performed by the [[New Jedi Order]] and [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Marines|marines]] in the year [[44 ABY]]. The Jedi Order, led by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and a group of Alliance marines loyal to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] infiltrated the Jedi Temple on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and attempted to eliminate the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] who had retreated into the Temple in response to the Order's elimination of almost a thousand Sith on Coruscant.

==Prelude==
In response to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] recent assassination of over a thousand disguised members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Lost Tribe]], the Sith at the order of Abeloth pulled all of their forces back into the [[New Jedi Temple|Temple]] following the advice of captive [[Wynn Dorvan]], who was attempting to minimize the collateral damage of the coming battle and to give the Jedi an advantage.

==The assault==
[[File:Skywalker_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Grand Master Skywalker led the Jedi invasion force]]
The first stage of the assault was a coordinated infiltration of the Temple through secret passages by groups of Jedi. Their primary objectives were to seize control of the computer systems and deactivate the shield generators, which would enable [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]]'s [[Void Jumper]]s to storm the Temple and drive out the Sith with the help of the Jedi.
<div style="float:right">[[File:Jaina_Apocalypse.jpg|thumb|180x|Jaina Solo was made a Master during the Assault]]</div>
During the next week the Jedi strike team struggled to reach their destination and accomplish their goal.
Finally after days of eluding Sith ambushes [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] were able to destroy a shield generator. All three of them were worn out and drawing on the Force for support; Jaina was in fact experiencing [[Force euphoria]]. As the most severely wounded, Solo volunteered to act as a human shield for the others in their retreat. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] recognized this sense of selfless sacrifice as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] material and promoted her then and there. They succeeded in escaping the Temple and immediately received medical care.<!-- Unfinished -->

===Skirmish in the loading bay===
During the assault, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], their granddaughter, [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]], and the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Bazel Warv]] attempted to warn a group of [[Barabel/Legends|Barabel]] Knights who had nested in the Temple of a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] Allana had of their nest coming under attack. However, they were intercepted by a group of Sith under [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sashal]], who had been chasing down [[Vestara Khai]]. They attacked the Solos and the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], as Khai had just revealed that a prophesied Jedi [[Queen/Legends|queen]] for whom the Sith had been searching was actually Allana Solo. The Sith were defeated, but Warv was killed and the Solos successfully warned the Barabels of Allana's vision.

===The hunt for Abeloth===
The initial attempts to lower the Temple's defenses to allow for the marines to enter the Temple failed, but the Jedi finally succeeded in taking out the Temple's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]].

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] were pulled from their [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tanks]] early, for a meeting of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)]]. Though it should be noted that [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] extracted himself early.

It was during this time [[Abeloth]] took [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Vestara Khai]] back to [[Abeloth's planet|her planet]] so they could recreate [[The Ones/Legends|The Ones]]. [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his niece [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] went after them.

On their way to [[Abeloth's planet]], Ship [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] ambushed them, so Luke went back buckled up and went [[Beyond shadows]] where he fought alongside [[Darth Krayt]], to destroy Abeloth's Force body while Ben and Vestara killed the body of Lady [[Korelei]].

[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]], accompanied by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tahiri Veila]] and a squad of the elite marines unit known as the [[Void Jumper]]s, landed in the Temple loading bay and continued into the Temple, while the Solos and the Barabel hatchlings they had rescued were evacuated aboard the former Imperial [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]'s shuttle the [[Parting Gift]]. At this point, the Jedi had learned from [[Wynn Dorvan]] that [[Abeloth]] had transferred part of her consciousness from her avatar [[Rokari Kem]] to the Temple's computer core, using the technique she learned when the entity absorbed the former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Callista Ming]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Saba Sebatyne]] killed her last avatar within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].

==Aftermath==
<!-- Feel free to fill in! -->

The [[Liberation of Coruscant (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|Battle of Coruscant]] would last for several weeks after the assault ended, as the remaining Sith who had fled the Temple were hunted down. Three months after the assault and the death of [[Abeloth]], Grand Master Skywalker would awake from the healing trance he had been in since the [[Duel at the Lake of Apparitions|duel with Abeloth]]. Where he learned that Abeloth had created lava flows killing billions, possibly trillions. At his decision, the Jedi Order would once again leave Coruscant, as many were blaming the Jedi for the recent destruction, and it would lessen the possibility of another attack on the capital. They would retreat to the planet [[Shedu Maad]] in the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], site of a Jedi base since the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].

[[Jagged Fel]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] would also marry not long after aboard the ''[[Dragon Queen II]]'', the flagship of [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]]. Tenel Ka and the Solos also decided that [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana Solo]] was ready to be revealed as the [[Chume'da]], and she attended the ceremony under her true name.
